gate: inner_train >= 5 AND inner_dev >= 1 verified questions per db

rules.anchor: NFKC normalize -> lowercase -> collapse whitespace runs to a single space -> strip; gold tables sorted ascending by (normalized_key, raw_simple_name); anchor = first table (IDENTICAL to Dev heldout_table_v5 anchor_key_rule)
rules.units: every (db, table) referenced by any verified question gold (pool = all referenced tables, not only anchors); one table one group
rules.weight: unit weight = number of verified questions anchored to that table
rules.assignment: order (-weight, table_name); target group = argmin current group weight; ties by fixed permutation numpy.random.RandomState(42).permutation(2) (recorded); 2-way form of the Dev five-fold greedy balance
rules.sides: inner-dev = verified questions ANCHORED to a group-1 table (evaluated once, gold keeps all tables/columns); inner-train = verified questions referencing NO group-1 table AND dup_group disjoint from inner-dev questions (v1 Q dup groups reused from opt_gold)
rules.exclusions: anchor-in-train-table questions referencing a dev table (ref_crossing) or sharing a dup_group with a dev question (dup_isolation) are in NEITHER side; unverified questions are out of the population; no relaxation applied
rules.isolation_assets: B/C/graph/pattern fitted on inner-train rows only; fresh engine cache dirs under data/h_splits/engine_cache/<db>/; engine constructed with heldout_tables=dev tables (fit-time hard isolation re-check)

isolation.method: every inner-train qid gold_tables asserted disjoint from dev target tables; train/test dup_group overlap empty; dev anchors all in dev group; sides disjoint; re-verified at engine fit via heldout_tables
